notes: Fixed Dashboard tile assignment showing only a stale subset of mapped drives when optical probing exceeded the short general polling timeout.
Drive polling now uses the longer hardware-command timeout, allowing all mapped drives to reach the Manager cache.
Fixed native Chrome and Windows dropdown option text becoming almost invisible against the light option-list background.
Added a Terminal button for every real Rip Node, opening its LAN-only Cockpit console on HTTPS port 9090.
Bundled Rip Node API remains v0.2.7 and all update installations remain manual-only.
